approved_amendments.scope: Perform read-only duplicate-package validation and create only its report and candidate register.
limits: No package or repository artifact may be deleted, moved, renamed, archived, overwritten, or regenerated.
Do not execute cleanup or package-building scripts.
Do not read secret values or follow paths outside the repository root.
Cleanup requires a separate itemized WCS and authority.

execution.objective: Validate package-artifact duplication claims using current repository evidence, without changing package or repository contents.
success_criteria: Reassess historical duplicate-package findings against current checkout state.
Compare candidate packages using content hashes, archive contents, manifests, provenance, references, and Git history; names alone do not prove duplication.
Classify each candidate with evidence, confidence, and disposition: IDENTICAL_DUPLICATE_CANDIDATE, DISTINCT, ACTIVE, PROTECTED, REVIEW, MISSING, or UNKNOWN.
Preserve artifacts with uncertain ownership, purpose, recovery value, or audit significance.
Create any audit report or register only under a separately approved authority.
Do not delete, move, rename, archive, overwrite, regenerate, or modify package artifacts; do not execute cleanup or package-building scripts.
Do not read secret values, follow paths outside the repository root, or modify runtime, database, deployment, or Supabase files.
State that identifying a duplicate candidate does not authorize its removal; cleanup requires a separate itemized WCS and authority.

unlocks: A separately reviewed, itemized package cleanup WCS if evidence supports it.

verified: The REP-STEWARD-009 roadmap lists Duplicate Package Validation as the second recommended authority.
The repository contains package artifacts and manifests under execution/packages and builder delivery locations.
not_yet_evidenced: Which current artifacts have identical contents or equivalent payloads.
Whether apparent duplicates have distinct authority, provenance, recovery, or audit purposes.

forbidden_surface: Package creation, regeneration, overwrite, or mutation
Deletion, movement, rename, archive, or cleanup

founder_runtime_test.test_definition: No application runtime change is authorized.
founder_runtime_test.expected_outcome: Draft WCS staged for review; no package audit or repository mutation is performed.
